name: Coateary
look: a small pale-blue creature with big purple eyes and blue earmuffs, wrapped in an enormous white fur rising in two great loops over its head, wrapping round its middle and ending in a blue pom-pom
entry: Its fur grows so long that it wraps it round itself like a great coat. It reads the thoughts of those lost in the cold and leads them home, wrapping the smallest in a loop of its fur.
